import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { SettingsService } from '../../services/settings.service'; import { GravitySettings } from '../../models/settings.model'; /** * Team Lead & Project Manager Priora Engine Customization Page. * Allows Lead to customize formula factor toggles and define a Custom Dependency Weight Factor. */ @Component({ selector: 'app-settings', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `

Priora Engine Settings

Customize active score calculation factors and define custom team lead dependency weights.

Priora settings updated successfully! Scores will recalculate dynamically across all canvas zones.

Formula Weight Factors

Toggle which mathematical variables influence the priority score calculation across all canvas zones.

Custom Dependency Weight

Define a custom dependency weight factor. When enabled, this dependency selection will be available during task creation.

` }) export class SettingsComponent implements OnInit { settings: GravitySettings = { id: 1, enableDependencyScore: true, enableDeadlineProximityScore: true, enableStagnationScore: true, enableWorkloadDensityScore: true, requireApprovalForDevTasks: false, enableCustomFactor: false, customFactorName: 'Security Risk Weight', customFactorPoints: 15.0 }; saving = false; savedSuccess = false; constructor(private settingsService: SettingsService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.settingsService.loadSettings(); setTimeout(() => { this.settings = { ...this.settingsService.settings() }; }, 100); } onSave(): void { this.saving = true; this.savedSuccess = false; this.settingsService.updateSettings(this.settings).subscribe({ next: (updated) => { this.settings = updated; this.saving = false; this.savedSuccess = true; setTimeout(() => this.savedSuccess = false, 4000); }, error: () => this.saving = false }); } }
